headline: HYBE JAPAN launches tender offer for KeyHolder shares and rights at ¥1,200 per share.
key_facts: Offer period runs from 2026-11-19 to 2027-01-06 (30 business days).
Price is ¥1,200 per common share and ¥1 per share acquisition right.
Minimum purchase is 8,751,630 shares in total: 7,148,690 common shares and 160,294 rights (1,602,940 shares underlying).
Maximum purchase is 10,453,092 shares in total: 8,850,152 common shares and 1,602,940 shares underlying the rights; post-offer ownership at maximum is 51.42%.

Tender agreements cover 7,148,690 common shares (34.26%) held by J Trust Co., Ltd., Omotesando Capital Co., Ltd. and Fujisawa Nobuyoshi, and 160,294 rights held by Akimoto Yasushi, Akimoto Shinsuke and Akatsuka Yoshihiro.
stated_purpose: To make KeyHolder a consolidated subsidiary of HYBE JAPAN, and as KeyHolder's parent company to contribute to the realization of its medium- to long-term improvement in corporate value. The filing states it does not intend to delist KeyHolder shares.

headline: BUFFALO INC. files issuer self-tender offer for common shares; buyback capped at 4,000,000 shares.
key_facts: Filed 2026-11-19 under Form No. 2 with the Director-General of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau; security type is common shares.
Board on 2026-05-14 set buyback caps of 4,000,000 shares and a total of 11,200,000,000 yen (112億円).
Buyback period set as 2026-05-15 to 2027-04-30.
Buyback scheme combines ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading, this tender offer, and market purchases.
Planned tender-offer target: Kabushiki Kaisha Melco Group holds 8,440,558 shares (35.57%); it indicated on 2026-09-17 it would consider tendering 2,700,000 shares (11.38%).
stated_purpose: To lower equity to a certain extent and improve capital efficiency so that consolidated ROE of 15% or more can be continuously achieved, while maintaining financial soundness; the scheme is also aimed at addressing foreign investor ratio, TOPIX constituent and free-float ratio considerations, with the main target of the tender offer stated as shares held by Melco Group.
